summary: A good thinking daily: every answer is a name people know, and the trap (big crowded countries like India and Japan are nowhere near) is the lesson. Better as a classic list than as Blitz.
reasons: Casual run: Monaco, Singapore, Hong Kong, Bangladesh, Vatican, Macau, Malta (7/10), but India (#31), China (#86), Japan, Netherlands and South Korea took all five lives. Harsh, yet each miss teaches density vs population.
Fan gets 10/10 with Bermuda (#12) and San Marino (#24) as fair misses. Gibraltar, Bahrain and Maldives are the satisfying stretch answers. Values match the Wikipedia table.
Blitz works (30 of 31 scored) but nearly every country scores, so it plays like naming countries; the classic version has the better puzzle.
fixes: Junk redirect aliases on top-10 entries: Monaco 'France–Monaco border', 'Monaco–France border', 'Fort-Hercule', 'Monegasque culture', 'Monegasque geography'; Singapore 'HUB in a Singapore context'; Gibraltar 'Gibraltar Health Authority', 'Gibraltar Group Practice Medical Scheme'; Vatican City 'Vatican City culture', 'Vatican City cuisine', 'Vatican citizenship', 'Roman Catholicism in Rome', "St. Joseph's Fountain"; Maldives 'Fushifarurah', 'Iru fushi', 'Irufushi' (single islands). Drop redirects naming borders, forts, institutions, culture/cuisine/geography subtopics and sub-islands.
